project.name: popsim-transport-predictor
project.description: Tokamak plasma transport prediction study using the POPSIM ML framework. Trains and compares model architectures (SciML hybrids, NNs, transformers, TORAX-backed simulators) for cross-device transfer learning between C-Mod, DIII-D, and TCV, across three studies: profile_transfer, power_balance_transfer, and transport_transfer.

nodes.name: run_case_analysis_parallel

nodes.name: normalization.py
nodes.summary: Defines the InputNormalizer family of POPSIM modules (raw, physics, z-score, CORAL, physics-coral, physics-zscore) that normalize the 7 physical power-balance inputs per device, plus the CoralFeatureNormalizer and ZScoreFeatureNormalizer stat stages reused by the profile and transport feature normalizers. Stats are fitted from training data only and stored as frozen buffers that checkpoint with the model but are never trainable.
nodes.languageNotes: Normalization statistics are frozen equinox buffers - they checkpoint with the model, and trainable selectors deliberately pick only module.nn leaves.

nodes.name: InputNormalizer
nodes.summary: Abstract TimeIndepModule base for normalizing the 7 physical power-balance inputs plus ds_source_idx; assembles the input vector and dispatches to a per-method _normalize_vec.

nodes.name: ZScoreNormalizer
nodes.summary: Per-device z-score normalizer with fitted means/stds buffers; unfitted devices pass through unchanged.

nodes.name: CoralNormalizer
nodes.summary: Per-device CORAL normalizer that whitens each device's feature covariance using fitted means and transform matrices.

nodes.name: PhysicsCoralNormalizer
nodes.summary: Two-stage normalizer that maps inputs to the dimensionless physics feature space then applies CORAL covariance alignment fitted in that space.

nodes.name: PhysicsZScoreNormalizer
nodes.summary: Two-stage normalizer applying per-device z-score standardization in the dimensionless physics feature space.

nodes.name: CoralFeatureNormalizer
nodes.summary: Generic per-device CORAL stat stage over an arbitrary feature vector; the building block behind the profile and transport physics-coral normalizers.

nodes.name: ZScoreFeatureNormalizer
nodes.summary: Generic per-device z-score stat stage over an arbitrary feature vector; the building block behind the profile and transport physics-zscore normalizers.

nodes.name: physics_feature_vec
nodes.summary: Maps the 7 raw physical inputs to the dimensionless physics feature vector (e.g. Greenwald fraction, q_star style quantities) shared by all physics-based normalization methods.

nodes.name: fit_z_score_stats
nodes.summary: Computes per-device means and stds over a feature matrix, leaving identity stats for devices absent from the fit data.

nodes.name: fit_coral_stats
nodes.summary: Fits per-device CORAL means and whitening transforms with safeguards: degenerate features keep identity slots, whitening gain is bounded, and devices below a shot-count gate fall back to identity.

nodes.name: feature_fit_arrays
nodes.summary: Extracts the stacked feature matrix and ds_source_idx arrays from a dataset for fitting a feature normalizer.

nodes.name: make_feature_normalizer
nodes.summary: Single dispatch point for feature-space normalization methods (physics identity / physics-coral / physics-zscore); a None fit dataset yields identity buffers with the checkpoint's pytree structure.

nodes.name: make_normalizer
nodes.summary: Factory building the power-balance InputNormalizer for a named method, fitting stats from the training dataset when required.

nodes.name: module.py
nodes.summary: Power balance POPSIM modules predicting stored-energy (Wtot_MJ) evolution with a simple-Euler stepper: sciml-taue-scalinglaw (H89/H98 tau_e blend gated by a P_LH scaling), sciml-taue-nn (bounded NN tau_e in a physics dW/dt balance), an unstructured MLP, and a recurrent causal-attention transformer with a rolling predicted-Wtot history buffer. PowerBalanceEnv seeds state and picks trainable leaves per domain-adaptation mode.
nodes.languageNotes: The transformer carries past PREDICTED Wtot values as discrete no-save state; a learned per-slot position embedding is needed because scalar tokens are otherwise permutation-invariant.

nodes.name: BoundedNNPredictor
nodes.summary: Wraps an MLP so its scalar output is smoothly bounded to [min_val, max_val]; used as the NN tau_e predictor.

nodes.name: ScalingLawPredictor
nodes.summary: Empirical confinement-time predictor blending L-mode and H-mode scaling laws (IPB98, ITER89, ITER96 factories) gated by a P_LH transition scaling; consumes physical units.

nodes.name: PowerBalance
nodes.summary: TimeDepModule base for all power balance model types: defines the Wtot_MJ state, input schema, positivity clamping and dW/dt bounding shared by every architecture.

nodes.name: PowerBalanceScalingLaw
nodes.summary: sciml-taue-scalinglaw model: physics power balance dW/dt = P_aux + P_oh - P_rad - Wtot/tau_e with tau_e from ScalingLawPredictor and p_oh/p_rad submodule predictors restored from prereq checkpoints.

nodes.name: PowerBalanceSciML
nodes.summary: sciml-taue-nn model: same physics power balance but with a bounded NN tau_e over normalized inputs, holding p_oh/p_rad submodules trained as their own prereq cases.

nodes.name: PowerBalanceUnstructuredNN
nodes.summary: mlp model type: an MLP over normalized inputs directly predicts dW/dt with no physics structure.

nodes.name: PowerBalanceTransformer
nodes.summary: Recurrent causal-attention model: an embedded-input query attends over a rolling buffer of past predicted Wtot tokens plus learned position embeddings, carried as discrete no-save state seeded from measured t0 Wtot.

nodes.name: PowerBalanceEnv
nodes.summary: ModuleTrainingEnv for the power balance study: creates initial state from measured t0 signals, builds inputs from the dataloader, and selects trainable leaves respecting freeze_submodules and domain-adaptation mode.

nodes.name: module.py
nodes.summary: OhmicPower predictor module: an MLP over normalized power-balance inputs predicting the ohmic heating power P_oh_MW, trained standalone as a prereq case and embedded as a submodule of the sciml power balance models.

nodes.name: OhmicPower
nodes.summary: TimeIndep predictor of P_oh_MW: owns an InputNormalizer and an MLP; init builds the network and fits the normalizer from training data.

nodes.name: trb.py
nodes.summary: TrainRunBuilder for the ohmic power predictor: a two-line subclass of ScalarPowerTRB that only sets SIGNAL to P_oh_MW and MODULE_CLS to OhmicPower; sweep configs reference it by this dotted path.

nodes.name: OhmicPowerTRB
nodes.summary: ScalarPowerTRB subclass pinning SIGNAL='P_oh_MW' and MODULE_CLS=OhmicPower.

nodes.name: module.py
nodes.summary: RadiatedPower predictor module: an MLP over normalized power-balance inputs predicting the radiated power P_rad_MW, trained standalone as a prereq case and embedded as a submodule of the sciml power balance models.

nodes.name: RadiatedPower
nodes.summary: TimeIndep predictor of P_rad_MW: owns an InputNormalizer and an MLP; init builds the network and fits the normalizer from training data.

nodes.name: trb.py
nodes.summary: TrainRunBuilder for the radiated power predictor: a two-line subclass of ScalarPowerTRB that only sets SIGNAL to P_rad_MW and MODULE_CLS to RadiatedPower; sweep configs reference it by this dotted path.

nodes.name: RadiatedPowerTRB
nodes.summary: ScalarPowerTRB subclass pinning SIGNAL='P_rad_MW' and MODULE_CLS=RadiatedPower.

nodes.name: scalar_power_trb.py
nodes.summary: Shared TrainRunBuilder base for the scalar power predictors (p_oh, p_rad): builds time-independent dataloaders via resolve_case_datasets, initializes the MODULE_CLS predictor with its normalizer, and wires loss, optimizer and eval suites parameterized only by the SIGNAL and MODULE_CLS ClassVars.

nodes.name: ScalarPowerTRB
nodes.summary: TrainRunBuilder base whose subclasses set SIGNAL and MODULE_CLS; provides dataloaders, model_init with normalizer fitting, MSE-style loss, exponential AdamW optimizer, val/test eval suites and a trainable getter.

nodes.name: trb.py
nodes.summary: TrainRunBuilder for the power balance study: segment-based time-dependent dataloaders via get_time_dep_dataloaders, model_init dispatching over the four model types (restoring p_oh/p_rad submodule checkpoints for the sciml types), a Wtot loss with training-only anchor terms tying submodule predictions to measured P_oh_MW/P_rad_MW, and a grouped AdamW that runs submodules at a reduced learning rate.
nodes.languageNotes: Anchor terms are training-loss only so val/loss.mean stays pure Wtot; they are a no-op for model types whose target_vars lack the power signals.

nodes.name: PowerBalanceTRB
nodes.summary: TrainRunBuilder wiring the power balance study end to end: dataloaders, per-model-type model_init with submodule checkpoint restoration, anchored Wtot training loss vs pure val loss, grouped exponential AdamW with submodule_lr_factors, and time-integrated error test eval suite.

nodes.name: module.py
nodes.summary: Time-independent profile predictor modules mapping 10 dimensionless plasma inputs to Te/ne profiles on a uniform 51-point rho grid: B-spline shape bases weighted by an NN (shape_init with PCA or k-means initial guesses), an echo-state reservoir, and an unstructured MLP; also defines the Inputs feature engineering (q_star, Greenwald fraction, beta, nu_star, ...) and the shared nn-input normalizer factory.

nodes.name: ProfileShape
nodes.summary: B-spline basis profile shape over rho with normalized coefficients; supports evaluation, integration and visualization, and constructs bases from spline knots or control points.

nodes.name: Inputs
nodes.summary: Dataclass of the profile predictor's physical inputs with derived dimensionless quantities (epsilon, q_star, fGW, beta, nu_star, ...) culminating in the 10-slot nn_inputs feature vector.

nodes.name: ProfilePredictor
nodes.summary: Abstract TimeIndepModule base for all profile predictor families, holding the rho grid, the NN and the input normalizer.

nodes.name: ProfilePredictorShapeInit
nodes.summary: shape_init model family: an NN softmax-weights a bank of Te/ne B-spline shapes (PCA- or k-means-initialized, optionally frozen) to produce profiles.

nodes.name: ProfilePredictorReservoir
nodes.summary: Echo-state reservoir model: fixed random input/reservoir weights iterated n_steps with leaky integration, with only the readout trainable.

nodes.name: ProfilePredictorUnstructuredNN
nodes.summary: Unstructured MLP model family predicting Te/ne values directly on the rho grid from normalized inputs.

nodes.name: nn_input_matrix
nodes.summary: Stacks the 10 dimensionless nn_inputs over all samples of a dataset into a feature matrix for normalizer fitting.

nodes.name: make_nn_input_normalizer
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper over make_feature_normalizer building the 10-feature profile-space normalizer (physics / physics-coral / physics-zscore).

nodes.name: kmeans_initial_guess
nodes.summary: K-means clustering of training Te/ne profiles to seed the shape_init_kmeans basis shapes.

nodes.name: pca_initial_guess
nodes.summary: PCA decomposition of training Te/ne profiles to seed the shape_init_pca basis shapes.

nodes.name: torax_module.py
nodes.summary: Differentiable TORAX-backed profile predictor: JAX-traceable circular and Miller geometry builders, a jitted TORAX relaxation loop, NN-predicted transport/edge/source parameters bounded to physical ranges, and the ProfilePredictorTorax module that relaxes TORAX to a steady profile per timeslice. Also owns the TORAX knob bounding (bound_transport_coefficients, transport_provider_mapping) shared with the transport predictor.
nodes.languageNotes: Geometry builders are written to be JAX-differentiable end to end so gradients flow through the TORAX solver into the NN parameter networks.

nodes.name: build_circular_geometry_jax
nodes.summary: Builds a JAX-traceable TORAX circular geometry from R_major, a_minor, B0 and elongation, computing the flux-surface metric quantities analytically.

nodes.name: build_miller_geometry_jax
nodes.summary: Builds a JAX-traceable Miller geometry with independent top/bottom triangularity (delta_exponent-shaped interpolation), deriving the full set of TORAX flux-surface metrics numerically.

nodes.name: clamp_core_profiles
nodes.summary: Clamps TORAX core profile state to physical floors to keep the relaxation loop numerically safe.

nodes.name: _run_loop_jit_with_geo
nodes.summary: Jitted fixed-geometry TORAX stepping loop with optional gradient checkpointing, applying runtime parameter overrides each step up to max_steps.

nodes.name: bound_transport_coefficients
nodes.summary: Bounds raw NN transport-network outputs to physical ranges per transport model (constant/cgm/gyrobohm/qlknn); shared by the profile and transport TORAX modules.

nodes.name: transport_provider_mapping
nodes.summary: Maps bounded transport coefficients to the TORAX runtime-params override dict for each transport model; shared by the profile and transport TORAX modules.

nodes.name: ProfilePredictorTorax
nodes.summary: TORAX-backed profile predictor: NNs predict transport, edge and source parameters from normalized inputs, then a jitted TORAX relaxation evolves profiles to steady state on the chosen (circular or Miller) geometry; heating magnitude is NN-inferred with fixed 0.9 absorption.

nodes.name: train_configs.py
nodes.summary: Declarative training configuration dictionaries for every profile predictor model family (shape_init_pca/kmeans, unstructured_nn, reservoir, torax-*), referencing ProfilePredictorTRB by dotted path, plus make_profile_predictor_torax_config which assembles the TORAX model-family config for a given transport model and geometry builder.

nodes.name: make_profile_predictor_torax_config
nodes.summary: Builds the torax-* model family training config for a given transport model, geometry builder and delta_exponent.

nodes.name: module.py
nodes.summary: Time-dependent transport predictor modules evolving ne/te profiles on the rho grid from power-balance inputs plus triangularities (beta derived from the evolving Wtot state, no measured betan): a transformer with a rolling predicted-profile history buffer, a sciml composition of trained PowerBalance and ProfilePredictor modules with anchored Wtot/P_oh/P_rad predictions, and TORAX one-step variants (rebuild vs carry ToraxSimState) that feed measured P_aux directly and learn only deposition shape, fueling and a Beer-Lambert absorption fraction. TransportPredictorEnv seeds state and selects trainables.
nodes.languageNotes: absorption_fraction = 1 - exp(-ne20_line_avg * softplus(nn)) is always in (0,1) and never gradient-dead at saturation, unlike a fixed absorption constant.

nodes.name: Inputs
nodes.summary: Transport predictor input dataclass with Wtot-derived dimensionless features (beta_from_wtot, betan_from_wtot, nu_star_from_wtot, ...), the 11-slot transport_nn_inputs vector, and converters to PowerBalance and ProfilePredictor input schemas.

nodes.name: transport_nn_input_matrix
nodes.summary: Stacks the 11 transport features over all samples of a dataset into a matrix for feature-normalizer fitting.

nodes.name: make_transport_nn_input_normalizer
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper over make_feature_normalizer building the 11-feature transport-space normalizer (physics / physics-coral / physics-zscore).

nodes.name: wtot_from_profiles
nodes.summary: Computes stored energy Wtot_MJ from ne/te profiles via a volume integral over the rho grid.

nodes.name: TransportPredictor
nodes.summary: TimeDepModule base for all transport predictor families: profile state schema and positivity clamping shared by every architecture.

nodes.name: TransportPredictorTransformer
nodes.summary: Recurrent causal-attention model: a current-feature query attends over position-embedded tokens of past PREDICTED profiles carried as a rolling discrete-state history buffer; only predictions enter the history, never past input features.

nodes.name: TransportPredictorSciML
nodes.summary: sciml composition: a trained PowerBalance evolves the Wtot state and a trained ProfilePredictor consumes the state-implied betan; the Output surfaces Wtot/P_oh/P_rad predictions so the loss can anchor them to measured signals.

nodes.name: TransportPredictorToraxBase
nodes.summary: Shared TORAX one-step machinery: NN transport/edge/source parameter networks, geometry building, measured P_aux fed straight to generic_heat.P_total with an NN-predicted deposition shape, gas-puff fueling and Beer-Lambert absorption fraction, advancing one 1 ms solver step per call.

nodes.name: TransportPredictorTorax
nodes.summary: torax_state='rebuild' variant: re-seeds TORAX from the stored ne/te profile state each step, then advances one solver step.

nodes.name: TransportPredictorToraxSimState
nodes.summary: torax_state='carry' variant: keeps the full ToraxSimState between steps as discrete state instead of rebuilding from profiles.

nodes.name: TransportPredictorEnv
nodes.summary: ModuleTrainingEnv for the transport study: seeds each architecture's state from measured t0 signals in the dataloader's state_vars and builds trainable selections, delegating the sciml power-balance subtree to PowerBalanceEnv.

nodes.name: trb.py
nodes.summary: TrainRunBuilder for the transport study: segment-based time-dependent dataloaders, model_init dispatching over transformer/sciml/torax-* (restoring PowerBalance and ProfilePredictor sub-checkpoints for sciml), a freshness-masked huber/val profile loss with unmasked anchor terms on Wtot/P_oh/P_rad, grouped AdamW running the power_balance subtree at reduced lr, and the profile test eval suite reused from ProfilePredictorTRB.
nodes.languageNotes: Profile loss terms are multiplied by the fresh_profiles mask so forward-filled timeslices steer neither training nor checkpoint selection; anchor terms stay unmasked because their measured signals exist at every timeslice.

nodes.name: TransportPredictorTRB
nodes.summary: TrainRunBuilder wiring the transport study: per-model-type model_init with submodule restoration, freshness-masked training/validation profile losses with anchor terms, grouped exponential AdamW with submodule_lr_factors, and ProfilePredictorTRB's test eval suite reused as-is.

nodes.name: trb_utils.py
nodes.summary: Helpers shared by every TrainRunBuilder: NaN-safe per-shot time integration of errors, the standard exponential AdamW plus a grouped variant applying submodule_lr_factors via optax multi_transform pytree-path labeling, the validation loss eval suite (fresh jitted closure per suite so eqx.filter_jit caches never collide across cases), per-case dataset selection (resolve_case_datasets incl. the transfer-pretrain normalizer-fit dataset), and segment-based time-dependent dataloader construction.

nodes.name: trapezoid_dropna
nodes.summary: Trapezoidal integration that drops NaN samples pairwise, for per-shot NaN-safe time integrals.

nodes.name: integrate_error_over_time
nodes.summary: Integrates a per-shot error time series over the shot's time axis using trapezoid_dropna.

nodes.name: make_exponential_adamw
nodes.summary: Builds the standard AdamW optimizer with exponential learning-rate decay from an optimizer config.

nodes.name: make_grouped_exponential_adamw
nodes.summary: Grouped AdamW applying per-subtree learning-rate factors (submodule_lr_factors) by pytree-path labeling via optax multi_transform, falling back to plain AdamW when no factors are set.

nodes.name: make_loss_eval_suite
nodes.summary: Builds the validation eval suite: mean val loss plus a <=100-point subsampled loss vector for wandb, creating a fresh jitted closure per suite so filter_jit caches never collide across cases.

nodes.name: mask_to_largest_contiguous_segment
nodes.summary: Masks each shot down to its largest contiguous NaN-free run across the training variables, for time-dependent rollout training.

nodes.name: resolve_case_datasets
nodes.summary: Per-case dataset selection and preparation shared by every study TRB: resolves train/val/test splits per training_data and domain_adaptation mode, including the transfer_pretrain normalizer-fit dataset passed via train_dl.normalizer_fit_ds.

nodes.name: get_time_dep_dataloaders
nodes.summary: Segment-based time-dependent dataloader construction on top of resolve_case_datasets, parameterized only by study_type; delegated to by both the power balance and transport TRBs.

nodes.name: plot_torax_evolution.py
nodes.summary: Diagnostic plotting for the TORAX profile predictor's relaxation: loads a single timeslice from a dataset, rebuilds a ProfilePredictorTorax from a checkpoint, runs the relaxation while recording per-step transport coefficients, and renders the profile evolution and coefficient traces to figures.

nodes.name: valid_timesteps
nodes.summary: Returns the timestep indices of a shot dataset with fully finite predictor inputs; also used by test fixtures to pick sample timeslices.

nodes.name: _build_module
nodes.summary: Constructs a ProfilePredictorTorax for a timeslice, optionally restoring NN weights from a checkpoint.

nodes.name: plot_relaxation
nodes.summary: Renders the TORAX relaxation: per-step Te/ne profile evolution against measurement plus transport coefficient traces, styled with the shared dark theme.

nodes.name: plot_torax_evolution
nodes.summary: End-to-end entry point: load timeslice, build module, run the relaxation with recorded coefficients, and write the evolution figures to output_dir.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Pytest fixtures for profile predictor tests: sample_timeslices loads bundled sample datasets and picks valid timeslices (filling in ds_source_idx, which the sample files predate), and make_torax_module builds a ProfilePredictorTorax with correct kwargs; TORAX-backed tests must use these instead of re-deriving module construction.

nodes.name: sample_timeslices
nodes.summary: Session fixture loading bundled sample datasets per device and selecting timeslices with valid predictor inputs, filling the missing ds_source_idx coordinate.

nodes.name: make_torax_module
nodes.summary: Fixture factory building a ProfilePredictorTorax for a given transport model and geometry from a sample timeslice.

nodes.name: test_miller_geometry.py
nodes.summary: Tests of the JAX Miller geometry builder: exact agreement with the circular builder in the zero-triangularity limit, metric closeness at small epsilon (known to exceed its 2 percent bound at HEAD), MAST-like shape invariants, up-down triangularity swap symmetry, differentiability of the metrics, and a slow no-NaN TORAX evolve on MAST Miller geometry.

nodes.name: build_miller
nodes.summary: Test helper constructing a Miller geometry from shape parameters on the shared test mesh.

nodes.name: test_miller_mast_invariants
nodes.summary: Checks MAST-like tight-aspect-ratio Miller geometry for physical invariants: finite positive metrics, monotonic volume and sane field quantities.

nodes.name: test_miller_geometry_differentiable
nodes.summary: Verifies gradients of Miller geometry metrics with respect to shape parameters are finite, keeping the builder usable inside the differentiable TORAX stack.

nodes.name: test_normalization.py
nodes.summary: Tests of the normalization module: identity/physics/z-score/CORAL correctness on a toy multi-device dataset, CORAL safeguards (degenerate-feature identity slots, bounded whitening gain, shot-count gate), identity-without-data contracts of both normalizer factories, non-trainability of stat buffers, feature-normalizer parity with the input normalizers, and consistency of normalize_domain feature spaces with the modules.

nodes.name: _toy_dataset
nodes.summary: Builds a synthetic two-device xarray dataset with controlled feature statistics for normalization tests.

nodes.name: test_coral_aligns_covariance
nodes.summary: Verifies fitted CORAL transforms whiten each device's feature covariance toward identity.

nodes.name: test_coral_degenerate_feature_keeps_identity_slot
nodes.summary: Checks that a zero-variance feature keeps an identity slot in the CORAL transform instead of blowing up.

nodes.name: test_coral_whitening_gain_bounded
nodes.summary: Checks the CORAL whitening gain is bounded so near-singular covariances cannot amplify features arbitrarily.

nodes.name: test_coral_shot_count_gate
nodes.summary: Verifies devices with too few shots fall back to identity CORAL stats via the shot-count gate.

nodes.name: test_power_balance_composite.py
nodes.summary: Tests of the composite (sciml) power balance behavior: anchor terms enter the training loss but never the val loss, respect device weights and vanish without power targets; structured Outputs carry submodule predictions; and the grouped AdamW applies submodule_lr_factors (scaling submodule updates, plain-AdamW fallback, transfer-partition labeling, and config stacking through make_train_config).

nodes.name: test_structured_outputs_carry_submodule_predictions
nodes.summary: Runs a sciml power balance step and checks the Output surfaces the p_oh/p_rad submodule predictions used by the anchor terms.

nodes.name: test_base_optimizer_config_carries_lr_factors
nodes.summary: Checks the power balance base optimizer config carries submodule_lr_factors (default 0.1x) into the built case config.

nodes.name: test_transfer_config_stacks_submodule_lr_factors
nodes.summary: Verifies transfer cases stack the transfer lr scaling with submodule_lr_factors when make_train_config wires the checkpoint.

nodes.name: test_trb_utils.py
nodes.summary: Tests of mask_to_largest_contiguous_segment: keeps only the longest contiguous NaN-free run per shot, splits runs when any training variable has a gap, and preserves the dims of per-shot variables.

nodes.name: test_keeps_only_longest_contiguous_run
nodes.summary: Verifies masking keeps exactly the longest contiguous valid run of each shot and NaNs everything else.

nodes.name: test_transport_module.py
nodes.summary: Architecture-level tests of the transport predictor modules: env state seeding per model type, trainable selections (incl. freeze_submodules and the sciml power-balance delegation), transformer position-embedding ordering and profiles-only history buffer, the TORAX measured-P_aux feed-through and Beer-Lambert absorption_fraction wiring, and feature-normalizer fitting over the 11 transport features.

nodes.name: sciml_module
nodes.summary: Fixture building a TransportPredictorSciML from small stub PowerBalance and ProfilePredictor submodules.

nodes.name: test_env_create_state_per_model_type
nodes.summary: Checks TransportPredictorEnv seeds the correct initial state for transformer, sciml and both torax variants from measured t0 observations.

nodes.name: test_env_get_trainable_selections
nodes.summary: Verifies trainable selections per model type: nn leaves only, normalizer buffers frozen, and freeze_submodules respected including the sciml power-balance subtree.

nodes.name: test_transformer_position_embedding_orders_history
nodes.summary: Shows the transformer's output depends on history order via the learned position embedding, guarding against permutation invariance of scalar tokens.

nodes.name: test_transformer_history_holds_profiles_only
nodes.summary: Checks the transformer's rolling history buffer stores only predicted profiles, never past input features.

nodes.name: test_torax_p_aux_feed_through
nodes.summary: Verifies measured P_aux_MW reaches TORAX generic_heat.P_total directly while the NN predicts only deposition shape, fueling and absorption.

nodes.name: test_torax_absorption_fraction_nn
nodes.summary: Checks absorption_fraction = 1 - exp(-ne20_line_avg * softplus(nn)) stays in (0,1), responds to the NN and to density, and never saturates gradient-dead.

nodes.name: test_torax_absorbed_power_matches_absorption_fraction
nodes.summary: Verifies the absorbed power delivered to TORAX equals P_aux times the predicted absorption fraction in the carry-state variant.

nodes.name: test_normalizer_fit_features
nodes.summary: Fits the transport feature normalizer on a synthetic dataset and checks the fitted stats match the 11 transport_nn_inputs features per device.

nodes.name: test_loss_fn.py
nodes.summary: Tests of the transport study's freshness-masked loss: stale (forward-filled) timeslices contribute zero profile loss, the fresh mask zeroes exactly the stale slices, and the anchor terms on Wtot/P_oh/P_rad remain exempt from the mask because their measured signals exist at every timeslice.

nodes.name: _pred_and_targ
nodes.summary: Builds matching prediction and target pytrees with a controllable fresh_profiles mask and offset for loss tests.

nodes.name: test_fresh_mask_zeroes_only_stale_slices
nodes.summary: Checks the fresh_profiles mask zeroes profile loss exactly on stale timeslices and leaves fresh ones untouched.

nodes.name: test_anchor_terms_exempt_from_fresh_mask
nodes.summary: Verifies the Wtot/P_oh/P_rad anchor terms are unaffected by the freshness mask.

nodes.name: StudyConfig
nodes.summary: Frozen Pydantic model holding all study-wide settings (dataset paths, SLURM partitions, GPU types, W&B entity, training limits), with TOML round-trip, per-device source indexing, and the is_compatible config-lock check.

nodes.name: _ConfigProxy
nodes.summary: One-shot global proxy that forwards attribute access to the loaded StudyConfig and blocks reassignment, letting the whole package share a single `config` object.

nodes.name: load_config
nodes.summary: Binds a StudyConfig instance into the global proxy, enforcing the one-shot load semantics.

nodes.name: reset_config
nodes.summary: Clears the bound global config so tests can reload a fresh StudyConfig between cases.

nodes.name: physics_methods.py
nodes.summary: DIII-D-specific physics extraction: pedestal and programmed parameters, extended EFIT columns, and IDA profile loading with psi_n-to-rho mapping, all resampled onto the uniform 1 kHz timebase.

nodes.name: find_ida_path
nodes.summary: Locates the IDA profile file for a DIII-D shot by testing a list of path patterns.

nodes.name: Uniform1kHzTimeSetting
nodes.summary: Time-setting class producing the uniform 1 kHz shot timebase used when retrieving DIII-D signals.

nodes.name: _rho_of_psi_n
nodes.summary: Maps a psi_n grid to normalized toroidal rho per timeslice using EFIT equilibrium quantities, interpolated across the shot's time axis.

nodes.name: D3DDatasetMethods
nodes.summary: Mixin of DIII-D data-retrieval methods: pedestal parameters, programmed pointnames, extended EFIT parameters, and IDA ne/Te profiles with gradients and error bars.

nodes.name: trb.py
nodes.summary: TrainRunBuilder for the profile predictor: builds time-independent dataloaders, model init with input normalizers, the huber-training vs error-bar-weighted-validation loss split, optimizer, transfer trainable getters, and val/test eval suites for every profile model family.
nodes.languageNotes: The training and validation losses come from one builder with a use_huber switch; validation is delta-free with residuals inside GP-fit error bars down-weighted by within_error_weight so the sweep metric cannot be gamed.

nodes.name: resolve_relaxation_overrides
nodes.summary: Resolves TORAX relaxation-related overrides (e.g. solver step counts) from a model_init config into the concrete module kwargs.

nodes.name: ProfilePredictorTRB
nodes.summary: TrainRunBuilder implementing dataloaders via resolve_case_datasets, model_init per model family (shape-init, unstructured NN, reservoir, TORAX variants), the profile loss pair, exponential AdamW optimizer, per-model-type trainable selections, and eval suites reused by the transport study.

nodes.name: organize_data.py
nodes.summary: Central dataset preparation for all studies: per-study signal prep (get_ds), NaN-padded shot concatenation, hazard scoring, uniform-timebase reindexing, whole-dataset domain normalization for visualization, and the train/val/test splitting variants including domain adaptation and transfer pretraining.

nodes.name: TrainingData
nodes.summary: Hashable descriptor of a training-data selection: unsorted device sources plus the exnihilo flag, with deterministic string form and config-driven source indices used in case names.

nodes.name: parse_training_data
nodes.summary: Parses a training-data string (underscore-joined device names, exnihilo handling) back into a TrainingData object.

nodes.name: add_missing_profile_companions
nodes.summary: Fills in gradient and error-bar companion variables for datasets that lack them (live TCV support, since TCV produces no GP-fit gradients).

nodes.name: concat_with_nan_padding
nodes.summary: Concatenates xarray datasets along one dimension while NaN-padding another so shots of different lengths can share a single array.

nodes.name: reindex_to_uniform_timebase
nodes.summary: Puts processed datasets back on the canonical 1 kHz timebase, turning mid-shot dt gaps left by filtering into explicit NaN slices and rejecting oversampled input.

nodes.name: get_ds
nodes.summary: Selects and prepares per-study signals from a source dataset: profile_transfer rho-grid profiles, power_balance scalar inputs with summed P_aux_MW, or the transport union with forward-filled profiles and fresh_profiles flags.

nodes.name: get_train_val_datasets
nodes.summary: Builds the 80/20 train/validation split over the selected source devices for a study type.

nodes.name: _split_target_shots

nodes.name: get_train_test_datasets
nodes.summary: Builds train/test datasets for a case, mixing in num_target_shots target shots according to the domain-adaptation method while reserving the hazard-ranked test set.

nodes.name: get_transfer_pretrain_datasets
nodes.summary: Builds the source-only pretraining datasets for transfer cases, excluding the target device and matching the eventual fine-tune split.

nodes.name: _timeslice_panel

nodes.name: _shot_ylims

nodes.name: evolution_gifs

nodes.name: generate_case_reports

nodes.summary: Comparison figure of frozen vs unfrozen shape bases including per-shot frozen-minus-unfrozen difference panels.

nodes.name: geometry_builder_comparison
nodes.summary: Comparison figure of TORAX circular vs Miller geometry-builder cases.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Datasets package root defining the canonical 1 kHz uniform timebase constant and builder that every device workflow uses to grid its raw shot data.
nodes.languageNotes: Timebase is built from an integer millisecond count so float accumulation cannot drop or duplicate samples.

nodes.name: make_uniform_1khz_timebase
nodes.summary: Creates the study-wide uniform 1 kHz timebase up to a maximum time, rounded to exact milliseconds so no sample is dropped or duplicated by float accumulation.

nodes.name: cli.py
nodes.summary: Fire-based command-line entry point for dataset generation, exposing per-device subcommands (cmod, d3d, mast, tcv) that build cluster fit configs and run the device data workflows.

nodes.name: _build_cluster_config
nodes.summary: Constructs a ClusterFitConfig for distributed GP fitting from CLI flags, lazily importing the dispatcher so local runs need no cluster dependencies.

nodes.name: DatasetCLI
nodes.summary: Fire CLI class with one method per device (cmod, d3d, mast, tcv) that instantiates the matching DataWorkflow and drives raw-file generation and processing through a shared _execute helper.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: C-Mod dataset subpackage init declaring CMOD_DATASET_SIGNALS, the list of 0-D signals (plasma current, stored energy, powers, geometry) pulled from disruption_py for each shot.

nodes.name: cmod_dataset.py
nodes.summary: C-Mod device data workflow: pulls MDSplus data via disruption_py, extracts Thomson scattering fit inputs, runs GP profile fitting (locally or via the distributed prepare/assemble interface), and standardizes signals into the study schema.

nodes.name: CModDataWorkflow
nodes.summary: DataWorkflow subclass for Alcator C-Mod implementing the distributed-fitting interface: prepare_shot stages Thomson and EFIT data into a ShotFitInput, assemble_shot combines fit results into raw netCDF files, and per-shot TS-fit diagnostic PDFs are written via ts_fit_pdf. prepare_workers stays at 1 because disruption_py MDSplus connections are not thread-safe.

nodes.name: dispy_utils.py
nodes.summary: Helpers around disruption_py: passive loguru log settings that prevent disruption_py from wiping the CLI's log sinks, and a SQL summary-table query for shot selection.
nodes.languageNotes: passive_log_settings pre-sets disruption_py's logging-setup flag so its logger.remove() reset paths are skipped, preserving caller-configured sinks.

nodes.name: passive_log_settings
nodes.summary: Returns disruption_py LogSettings that leave the process's existing loguru sinks untouched, preventing the dataset CLI's run log from being silently emptied.

nodes.name: summary
nodes.summary: Queries the disruption_py summary database table for shots meeting plasma-current and pulse-length thresholds, returning the candidate shotlist for dataset building.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: GP fitting subpackage init; documents that fit_worker.py is the single source of truth for the fitting math and batch file format, kept importable with only numpy plus mkgp for shipping to remote clusters.

nodes.name: dispatcher.py
nodes.summary: SLURM cluster dispatcher for distributed GP profile fitting: plans shot batches, pushes packed batch files over SSH or local backends, submits and monitors fit jobs with retry across partitions, and collects fit results back.

nodes.name: parse_partition_specs
nodes.summary: Parses partition specification strings into PartitionSpec objects describing the SLURM partitions (and their limits) that fit jobs may target.

nodes.name: plan_batches
nodes.summary: Chunks the shots needing fits into deterministic batches, reusing existing batch files on disk so restarts do not re-pack already-staged work.

nodes.name: ClusterFitConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass configuring cluster-dispatched fitting: host, remote directories, partition specs, batch size, and timeouts, with validation in __post_init__.

nodes.name: _SlurmJobControl
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper over squeue/scancel for querying queued job names and states and cancelling jobs on a SLURM cluster.

nodes.name: _ShellJobControl
nodes.summary: Job control that runs SLURM commands through an SSH shell to a remote login node, including script submission and job state polling.

nodes.name: _SSHBackend
nodes.summary: File-transfer backend that pushes/pulls batch files and manages remote directories over SSH/rsync for remote-cluster fitting runs.

nodes.name: _LocalBackend
nodes.summary: Backend implementing the same push/pull/submit interface with local filesystem copies and direct sbatch calls, for running the dispatcher on the cluster itself.

nodes.name: BatchState
nodes.summary: Per-batch state record tracking job name, submission attempts, and paths, with reset_for_resubmit supporting retry on a different partition.

nodes.name: ClusterFitDispatcher
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full distributed fit run: packs ShotFitInputs into batch files, submits SLURM jobs via the chosen backend, polls for completion, handles pending timeouts and failures by retrying on other partitions, adopts already-queued jobs on restart, collects unpacked fit results, and cleans cluster state.

nodes.name: fit_worker.py
nodes.summary: Self-contained GP profile fitting worker (numpy + mkgp only) shipped alone to remote clusters: defines the ShotFitInput/ShotFitOutput batch npz format, outlier removal, hyperparameter fitting, monotonicity-constrained GP profile fits, and a CLI main that fits one batch file.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately imports only numpy and mkgp so the single file can be copied to a cluster without installing the transport_study package.

nodes.name: Tanh_WarpingFunction
nodes.summary: mkgp warping function using a tanh transform so the GP length scale shortens near the pedestal, letting one kernel resolve both the flat core and the steep edge.

nodes.name: ShotFitInput
nodes.summary: Dataclass carrying one shot's staged Thomson measurement arrays (x locations, values, errors per timeslice) into the fitting pipeline, with has_fittable_points validity check.

nodes.name: ShotFitOutput
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding one shot's GP fit results: profile means, error bars, and gradients per timeslice on the evaluation grid.

nodes.name: run_gp
nodes.summary: Runs a single GP regression on one timeslice's measurements with the warped kernel, optionally with monotonicity virtual points, returning mean, error, and gradient on the evaluation grid.

nodes.name: fit_gp_hyperparameters
nodes.summary: Optimizes GP kernel hyperparameters for a slice starting from rough estimates, falling back to pinned defaults when optimization fails.

nodes.name: gp_profile
nodes.summary: Top-level per-slice fit: cleans inputs, removes outliers, fits hyperparameters, runs the unconstrained GP, then re-fits with monotonicity virtual points when the fit shows a nonphysical edge bump, keeping the unconstrained fit if the constrained refit fails.

nodes.name: data_envelope
nodes.summary: Computes a nearest-neighbor envelope around the measured points used to detect fit excursions beyond what the data supports.

nodes.name: nonphysical_peak
nodes.summary: Detects nonphysical local maxima (e.g. edge bumps) in a fitted profile that exceed the data envelope, triggering the monotonicity-constrained refit.

nodes.name: _remove_local_outliers
nodes.summary: Removes measurement points that deviate strongly from their spatial neighbors before GP fitting, a first-pass local outlier screen.

nodes.name: _remove_outliers
nodes.summary: Second-pass outlier removal using leave-one-out standardized GP residuals, keeping points that are locally corroborated by neighbors so real pedestal structure is not culled.

nodes.name: pack_fit_batch
nodes.summary: Serializes a set of ShotFitInputs into a single npz batch file, the on-disk format shipped to cluster fit jobs.

nodes.name: unpack_fit_batch
nodes.summary: Deserializes an npz batch file back into per-shot ShotFitInput objects on the worker side.

nodes.name: pack_fit_results
nodes.summary: Serializes per-shot ShotFitOutputs into a results npz file written atomically by the worker for the dispatcher to pull back.

nodes.name: unpack_fit_results
nodes.summary: Deserializes a results npz file into per-shot ShotFitOutput objects, used by the dispatcher when collecting finished batches.

nodes.name: fit_variable
nodes.summary: Fits all timeslices of one profile variable (Te or ne) for a shot, repairing failed slices where possible and culling slices with too few points or unrecoverable fits.

nodes.name: _fit_slice
nodes.summary: Fits a single timeslice of a single variable, wrapping gp_profile with per-slice scaling and hyperparameter handling for use by fit_batch's serial and parallel paths.

nodes.name: fit_batch
nodes.summary: Fits an entire batch of shots (both profile variables, all timeslices), optionally in parallel across processes with fixed or per-slice hyperparameters and a max-slices-per-shot cap, returning ShotFitOutputs.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point run on cluster nodes: reads a packed batch npz, runs fit_batch, and atomically writes the packed results file.

nodes.name: mast_dataset.py
nodes.summary: MAST device data workflow: reads level1/level2 shot data from the public S3 store, maps Thomson scattering measurements to the midplane via LCFS geometry, stages fit inputs (S3-latency bound, 8 prepare workers), and assembles GP fit results into raw netCDF files.

nodes.name: check_required_signals
nodes.summary: Verifies a MAST shot's store contains all required signal groups before staging, so incomplete shots are skipped early.

nodes.name: _map_thomson_midplane
nodes.summary: Maps MAST Thomson scattering measurement radii onto normalized flux coordinates at the midplane using EFIT equilibrium data and the LCFS crossing radius.

nodes.name: MASTDataWorkflow
nodes.summary: DataWorkflow subclass for MAST implementing the distributed-fitting interface against the public S3 shot store: prepare_shot downloads and stages 0-D and Thomson data, assemble_shot builds raw netCDF plus the TS-fit diagnostic PDF, and device_specific_culling overrides the default profile-NaN rule.

nodes.name: plotting.py
nodes.summary: Dataset diagnostic plotting: per-shot power-balance and profile time plots, multi-page dataset summary reports, and the shared Thomson-fit-vs-GP diagnostic PDF (ts_fit_pdf) that C-Mod and MAST write per assembled shot.

nodes.name: ds_power_balance_time_plot
nodes.summary: Plots one shot's power-balance signal traces (stored energy, currents, powers) over time in the shared dark theme for dataset inspection.

nodes.name: ds_profile_time_plot
nodes.summary: Plots the time evolution of a shot's Te/ne profiles (values, error bars, gradients) for dataset diagnostics.

nodes.name: ds_profile_plot
nodes.summary: Plots individual profile snapshots against psi_n/rho for selected timeslices of a shot.

nodes.name: ds_summary_report
nodes.summary: Writes a multi-page PDF summary report for a processed dataset: per-shot summary pages plus aggregate statistics, used by the workflow's debug plotting stage.

nodes.name: fit_mean_ylim
nodes.summary: Computes a robust y-axis limit from fit means, falling back gracefully on degenerate (all-NaN or constant) fits.

nodes.name: ts_fit_pdf
nodes.summary: Writes the shared Thomson-scattering-vs-GP-fit diagnostic PDF, one page per fitted timeslice with configurable channel groups (C-Mod passes core/edge, MAST a single system), skipping unfitted and all-NaN slices.

nodes.name: tcv_dataset.py
nodes.summary: TCV device data workflow: loads pre-exported per-shot files (no GP fitting stage), resamples onto the uniform 1 kHz timebase, standardizes signal names, and applies TCV-specific processing and culling overrides.

nodes.name: TCVDataWorkflow
nodes.summary: DataWorkflow subclass for TCV that builds raw files from exported shot files rather than GP fits (TCV data ships without GP-fit gradients), creates the uniform timebase dataset per shot, and overrides device_specific_culling.

nodes.name: workflow.py
nodes.summary: Abstract DataWorkflow base for all device data acquisition: defines the raw-file variable schema (RAW_DATASET_VARS, PROFILE_FIT_VARS), the distributed prepare/assemble fitting driver, shot staging, common culling (duration, energy sanity, all-NaN), dimension standardization, and the processed-data pipeline with debug reports.
nodes.languageNotes: Template-method design: devices override _get_shotlist_from_source, prepare_shot/assemble_shot, standardize_signal_names, device_specific_processing, and device_specific_culling while the base owns staging, distribution, and common culling.

nodes.name: DataWorkflow
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for device workflows: make_raw_data_files_distributed drives prepare_shot/assemble_shot through the cluster dispatcher, stage_shots runs prepare_shot in a thread pool sized by prepare_workers, and run_processed_data_workflow applies filtering, transient cutoffs, profile-fit masking, duration and energy sanity culls, then writes processed netCDF plus summary reports.

nodes.name: train_configs.py
nodes.summary: Builds the one-step TORAX solver configuration for the transport predictor's torax-* model types, adapting the profile predictor's TORAX config to the 1 ms dataset timebase with measured P_aux fed straight to the heat source.

nodes.name: make_transport_torax_config
nodes.summary: Returns the TORAX config for one 1 ms solver step per module call, built on the profile predictor's TORAX config factory with transport-study overrides (measured P_total, NN-predicted deposition shape and absorption).

nodes.name: synthetic_shot.py
nodes.summary: Shared test helper that fabricates a synthetic raw shot dataset (profiles, powers, geometry on the uniform timebase) used by the workflow processing and culling tests.

nodes.name: raw_shot
nodes.summary: Builds a synthetic single-shot xarray Dataset with the raw-file variable schema so tests can drive workflow processing without device data.

nodes.name: test_gp_fitting.py
nodes.summary: Extensive test suite for GP fitting: fit_worker math (outlier handling, monotonicity constraint refits, batch npz round trips, parallel-vs-serial equivalence) and ClusterFitDispatcher behavior (retries, partition fallback, cleanup, job adoption) via a _FakeBackend, plus slow spot-check classes against real C-Mod and MAST data.

nodes.name: _FakeBackend
nodes.summary: In-memory fake of the dispatcher's backend and job-control interface, recording pushed files and simulating job lifecycles so dispatcher tests run without SSH or SLURM.

nodes.name: TestGPFitCMOD
nodes.summary: Slow spot-check tests running the production GP fit on a real C-Mod shot timeslice through CModDataWorkflow, verifying the fitted profile against known values.

nodes.name: TestGPFitMAST
nodes.summary: Slow spot-check tests running the production GP fit on a real MAST shot timeslice through MASTDataWorkflow.

nodes.name: test_mast_dataset_integration.py
nodes.summary: Slow integration tests for the MAST workflow against the public S3 store: shot 30284 must yield fittable Thomson slices, a production-quality single-slice fit, and a complete profiles dataset.

nodes.name: test_mast_psin_vs_rho.py
nodes.summary: Slow diagnostic test comparing MAST GP fits performed in psi_n versus rho coordinates on real data, writing a comparison PDF to check the coordinate choice does not distort profiles.

nodes.name: test_shot_processing.py
nodes.summary: Tests device_specific_processing behavior on synthetic shots: profile companions (error bars, gradients) are culled together, fresh-slice labeling survives mid-shot filter gaps, impossible stored energy culls the shot, and transient filters cut from before the event, for both C-Mod and MAST workflows.

nodes.name: test_stage_shots.py
nodes.summary: Tests DataWorkflow.stage_shots threading semantics with a _CountingWorkflow stub: serial-equivalent shot selection, concurrency, skipping already-staged shots, stopping at target without over-staging, and surviving invalid or raising shots.

nodes.name: _CountingWorkflow
nodes.summary: Minimal DataWorkflow subclass whose prepare_shot counts and gates calls, letting the stage_shots tests observe threading order and concurrency.

nodes.name: test_ts_fit_plot.py
nodes.summary: Tests the ts_fit_pdf diagnostic: one page per fitted slice, unfitted and all-NaN slices skipped, channel-group panels rendered, and fit_mean_ylim's degenerate-fit fallback.

nodes.name: test_workflow_duration_checks.py
nodes.summary: Tests the workflow's shot-duration culling on synthetic shots: dense-but-short and sparse-wide-span shots are excluded, accumulated time exactly at threshold is kept, and all-NaN shots are dropped.

nodes.name: test_workflow_energy_cull.py
nodes.summary: Tests energy_sanity_cull on synthetic shots for both C-Mod and MAST workflows: broken power records are culled, healthy shots kept, missing samples count as zero, and the check runs even when a device overrides device_specific_culling.

nodes.name: d3d_dataset.py
nodes.summary: DIII-D device data acquisition workflow: pulls per-shot signals via disruption-py MDSplus retrieval on a uniform 1 kHz timebase, standardizes signal names into the POPSIM schema, and writes raw NetCDF files. Also defines the INNER_WALL constant reused throughout trajectory optimization.

nodes.name: D3DDataWorkflow
nodes.summary: Implements the DataWorkflow interface for DIII-D: resolves shotlists from file patterns, fetches shot data through disruption-py get_shots_data, renames and derives signals (Wtot_MJ, betan, ne20_edge, Te/ne profiles), and applies device-specific NaN culling.

nodes.name: data.py
nodes.summary: Dataset preparation for the trajectory-optimization module: loads the DIII-D NetCDF, selects feedback-control shots and time windows, interpolates profiles onto a uniform psi_n grid, and attaches smoothed programmed signals. Part of the out-of-scope profile_trajectory legacy module.

nodes.name: correct_B0_prog
nodes.summary: Replaces the programmed B0 signal with a 100-sample rolling mean of the measured B0, since the recorded B0_prog is unreliable.

nodes.name: add_gapin_prog
nodes.summary: Derives a smoothed programmed inner-gap signal (gapin_prog) from the measured gapin via rolling mean with backward/forward fill.

nodes.name: get_ds
nodes.summary: Loads and windows the trajectory dataset: selects shots and time ranges, interpolates profiles onto a uniform psi_n grid, integrates line-averaged quantities, and applies the programmed-signal corrections.

nodes.name: module.py
nodes.summary: POPSIM TimeDepModule for direct trajectory optimization: learns programmed control waveforms (Ip, B0, shaping points) that are mapped through PCSInputMapper into a frozen ProfilePredictor to maximize predicted plasma performance. Out-of-scope legacy (trajectory_optimization study, inconclusive March 2026).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses equinox/chex dataclass modules with soft_clip bounding of trainable trajectory waypoints.

nodes.name: PCSInputMapper
nodes.summary: Maps controllable plasma-control-system quantities (R0, gapin, X-point coordinates) to the geometric inputs the profile predictor needs (a_minor, kappa, delta_top, delta_bot) using the inner-wall location.

nodes.name: ProfileTrajectoryOptimizer
nodes.summary: TimeDepModule holding trainable trajectory waypoints; resolve_targets soft-clips learned waypoint values into allowed input ranges, and __call__ maps the current trajectory point through PCSInputMapper into the frozen ProfilePredictor to produce predicted profiles.

nodes.name: ProfileTrajectoryOptimizerEnv
nodes.summary: ModuleTrainingEnv wiring: builds initial State and Inputs from the dataset and selects only the trajectory waypoints (not the frozen profile predictor) as trainable.

nodes.name: train_configs.py
nodes.summary: Default train-config dictionary (PROFILE_TRAJECTORY_OPTIMIZER_CONFIG) for the trajectory optimizer: dataloader signal lists, waypoint input ranges, trajectory times, optimizer schedule, and the shape-init profile predictor as a frozen submodule. Legacy.

nodes.name: trb.py
nodes.summary: TrainRunBuilder for the trajectory optimizer: builds augmented dataloaders via get_ds and make_augmented_dataset, restores the frozen profile predictor at model_init, and defines a performance-maximizing IntegralLoss (pressure and collisionality terms with relu constraint penalties) plus an AdamW exponential-decay optimizer. Legacy.

nodes.name: ProfileTrajectoryOptimizerTRB
nodes.summary: TrainRunBuilder implementing get_dataloaders (augmented ensemble dataset), model_init (restores frozen ProfilePredictor and builds ProfileTrajectoryOptimizer at trajectory times), get_loss_fn (performance objective with constraint penalties), a predicted-profiles eval suite, and the AdamW optimizer.

nodes.name: restore_predictor.py
nodes.summary: Restores trained profile predictors from checkpoint directories: parses case-directory names back into ProfileStudy.Case objects (must stay byte-synced with Case.__str__), locates the tuned config, and rebuilds the model via ProfilePredictorTRB before restoring weights.

nodes.name: checkpoint_to_profile_case
nodes.summary: Parses a checkpoint directory name (case string tokens) back into a ProfileStudy.Case, raising ValueError on unrecognized token layouts. Must stay in sync with Case.__str__; pinned by case-naming tests.

nodes.name: checkpoint_to_profile_config
nodes.summary: Builds a TrainConfig for a checkpoint directory by loading the case's tuned hyperparameter config and pointing it at that checkpoint.

nodes.name: restore_profile_predictor
nodes.summary: Reconstructs the ProfilePredictor model through ProfilePredictorTRB dataloaders and model_init, then restores the best checkpoint weights.

nodes.name: restore_profile_predictor_from_checkpoint
nodes.summary: One-call convenience wrapper: checkpoint directory to config to restored ProfilePredictor.

nodes.name: benchmark.py
nodes.summary: Trains and benchmarks the profile predictor and the trajectory optimization within trajopt operating ranges, producing per-profile error comparisons and optimized-trajectory performance figures. Out-of-scope legacy study.

nodes.name: run_profile_predictor_evaluation
nodes.summary: Trains (if needed) and evaluates the profile predictor on the trajectory dataset, caching evaluation NetCDFs and rendering profile comparison figures.

nodes.name: eval_profile_predictor
nodes.summary: Restores the best profile predictor checkpoint and runs its evaluation suite over the trajectory dataloaders.

nodes.name: plot_profiles
nodes.summary: Renders profile comparison figures for the raw augmented dataset without model predictions.

nodes.name: run_trajectory_evaluation
nodes.summary: Sweeps the number of allowed shape times, training and evaluating a trajectory optimizer for each, then compares pressure peaking-factor performance across optimized trajectories and the reference shot.

nodes.name: plot_trajectory_shapes
nodes.summary: Restores each swept trajectory-optimizer checkpoint and plots the optimized control waveforms against the original trajectory.

nodes.name: characterize_dataset.py
nodes.summary: Scopes the trajectory dataset: computes typical ranges of programmed inputs over Ip-ramp shots (to bound optimization variables) and programmed-vs-measured error on feedback-control shots (to size augmentation noise). Legacy.

nodes.name: get_trajectory_input_ranges
nodes.summary: Computes min, max, mean, and std of each programmed input over the Ip-ramp shot windows to set trajectory optimization bounds.

nodes.name: get_controllable_input_errors
nodes.summary: Measures typical error between programmed and measured signals on feedback-control shots, calibrating the PROG_INPUT_ERRORS augmentation magnitudes.

nodes.name: characterize_dataset
nodes.summary: Fire CLI entry combining input-range and input-error characterization and logging the results for use in setup_data constants.

nodes.name: optimize.py
nodes.summary: Trajectory optimization orchestrator: the TrajectoryOptimization class builds a case grid over (profile predictor checkpoint, number of trajectory times, optimize_density), launches SLURM training jobs with resource checks, and writes optimized trajectory outputs. Out-of-scope legacy.

nodes.name: TrajectoryOptimization
nodes.summary: Case-grid orchestrator for trajectory optimization runs: builds per-case train configs from PROFILE_TRAJECTORY_OPTIMIZER_CONFIG plus restored profile predictor configs, names checkpoints and results per case, runs or launches SLURM jobs, and exports the optimized trajectory dataset.

nodes.name: run_trajectory_optimization
nodes.summary: Fire CLI entry: instantiates TrajectoryOptimization for a profile predictor checkpoint and runs all cases, optionally fanned out in parallel on SLURM.

nodes.name: plotting.py
nodes.summary: Matplotlib figure builders for the trajectory optimization study: multi-prediction profile comparisons, peaking-factor performance comparisons, and optimized-versus-original control waveform panels, all in a dark theme. Legacy.

nodes.name: profile_comparison
nodes.summary: Plots each profile signal with the target dataset against multiple prediction datasets, one figure per signal, saved into a profile directory.

nodes.name: trajectory_performance_comparison
nodes.summary: Compares pressure peaking-factor performance across optimized trajectories and the reference shot in a summary figure.

nodes.name: trajectory_shapes_comparison
nodes.summary: Renders panels of optimized control waveforms (Ip, shaping points, density) against the original trajectory, shading the allowed input ranges.

nodes.name: predict_after.py
nodes.summary: Post-shot profile prediction: evaluates the profile predictor over a perturbation ensemble centered on the measured (not programmed) trajectory of a DIII-D shot, answering how well the model retrodicts the observed profiles. Legacy.

nodes.name: _fill_nan
nodes.summary: Linearly interpolates over NaN gaps in a 1D array, extending the end values outward.

nodes.name: _overwrite_prog_with_measured
nodes.summary: Replaces programmed trajectory signals with their NaN-filled measured equivalents so the perturbation ensemble centers on the actual shot trajectory.

nodes.name: run_postshot_prediction
nodes.summary: Fire CLI: loads the shot, swaps programmed signals for measured ones, runs the perturbed-ensemble profile prediction with a restored predictor, and writes comparison plots.

nodes.name: predict_first.py
nodes.summary: Pre-shot prediction pipeline for a planned DIII-D shot: runs the profile predictor over a perturbation ensemble of the programmed trajectory (optionally an optimized one) and renders diagnostics - input waveforms, prediction bands, trajectory comparisons, and profile evolution GIFs. Legacy.

nodes.name: run_preshot_prediction
nodes.summary: Builds the programmed-trajectory dataset for a target shot (optionally overriding signals from an optimized trajectory checkpoint), runs the ensemble prediction with a restored profile predictor, and saves NetCDF results plus figures.

nodes.name: _plot_predictor_inputs
nodes.summary: Plots the ensemble of predictor input waveforms (geometry, Ip, density) feeding the pre-shot prediction.

nodes.name: _plot_preshot_predictions
nodes.summary: Plots predicted Te and ne profile bands over time for the pre-shot ensemble.

nodes.name: _fresh_timestep_mask
nodes.summary: Builds a boolean mask of timeslices where the measured profile actually updated rather than being forward-filled.

nodes.name: _plot_trajectory_comparison
nodes.summary: Compares reference versus target shot programmed trajectories across all control signals.

nodes.name: _plot_prediction_vs_measured
nodes.summary: Overlays predicted profile bands on measured profiles at matched times for the target shot.

nodes.name: _make_profile_gif
nodes.summary: Renders an animated GIF of predicted versus measured profile evolution over the shot.

nodes.name: get_traj_shot_data
nodes.summary: Loads and prepares a single shot's trajectory data from the raw dataset for prediction, applying time windowing and programmed-signal corrections.

nodes.name: run_trajopts.py
nodes.summary: Batch driver that runs trajectory optimizations for multiple profile predictor checkpoints, recomputes cross-model loss metrics against a reference shot, and plots comparisons across trajopt runs. Legacy.

nodes.name: _profile_module_to_checkpoint_dir
nodes.summary: Maps a profile module label to its trained checkpoint directory under the profopt models directory.

nodes.name: _compute_loss_metrics
nodes.summary: Recomputes the trajectory optimizer's performance and constraint loss terms (pressure, effective collisionality, penalty terms) for an optimized trajectory evaluated under a given profile predictor.

nodes.name: run_trajopts
nodes.summary: Fire CLI: runs run_trajectory_optimization for every profile module found in the models directory.

nodes.name: compare_trajopts
nodes.summary: Aggregates loss metrics across every pairing of optimized trajectory and evaluating profile predictor to test cross-model agreement.

nodes.name: _plot_comparison
nodes.summary: Plots grids of loss-metric matrices comparing each optimized trajectory evaluated under each profile predictor.

nodes.name: setup_data.py
nodes.summary: Constants and augmentation for trajectory optimization: curated Ip-ramp and feedback-control shot windows, measured programmed-input error magnitudes, and make_augmented_dataset which perturbs programmed inputs with Gaussian noise to create a prediction ensemble. Legacy.

nodes.name: make_augmented_dataset
nodes.summary: Creates an augmented ensemble dataset by adding per-signal Gaussian noise, scaled by the measured programmed-input errors, across many permutations expanding the shot dimension.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer marking transport_study/orchestration as an importable Python package.

nodes.name: slurm_utils.py
nodes.summary: SLURM cluster interface for the study orchestration: queries job/GPU/partition state via squeue/sinfo/sacctmgr, picks partitions with spillover budgeting and GPU-type node exclusion, and submits training, W&B sweep-agent, per-case analysis, and trajectory-optimization jobs as generated sbatch scripts.
nodes.languageNotes: Builds standalone sbatch shell scripts embedding a Python config-reload preamble (_config_reload_script) so remote jobs reconstruct the frozen global StudyConfig from a saved TOML.

nodes.name: importable_module
nodes.summary: Recovers the dotted import path of a class by walking parent directories with __init__.py files, so generated job scripts can re-import study classes even when defined under __main__.

nodes.name: _config_reload_script
nodes.summary: Generates the Python preamble embedded in every sbatch script that reloads the saved study config TOML into the one-shot global config proxy on the remote node.

nodes.name: count_running_jobs
nodes.summary: Counts the user's currently running SLURM jobs matching a job name via squeue, returning 0 with a logged critical on scheduler failure.

nodes.name: get_running_job_names
nodes.summary: Returns the set of job names the user currently has running on the queried partitions via squeue.

nodes.name: get_running_job_elapsed_s
nodes.summary: Maps each running job name to its elapsed wall time in seconds, parsed from squeue output; feeds the stuck-job watchdog in Study.kill_stuck_jobs.

nodes.name: get_pending_job_pending_s
nodes.summary: Maps each pending job name to how long it has been queued in seconds, keeping the maximum per name; feeds the long-pending-job watchdog that cancels stale spillover submissions.

nodes.name: cancel_job
nodes.summary: Cancels the user's SLURM jobs matching a job name via scancel, optionally restricted to a partition and job state (e.g. PENDING only).

nodes.name: count_idle_gpus
nodes.summary: Estimates free GPUs on a partition by subtracting squeue-allocated GPU counts from sinfo totals, minus a safety buffer.

nodes.name: count_pending_jobs
nodes.summary: Counts the user's pending jobs on a partition via squeue, used to decide whether more submissions would just queue.

nodes.name: resources_available
nodes.summary: True when a partition has idle GPUs and the user has no pending jobs there - the gate pick_partition uses before choosing the primary partition.

nodes.name: count_user_jobs
nodes.summary: Counts all of the user's jobs across every partition, the input to the study-wide spillover budget.

nodes.name: _partition_info
nodes.summary: Fetches a partition's key=value attribute dict from scontrol show partition, shared by the QoS-cap and time-limit lookups.

nodes.name: partition_user_gpu_cap
nodes.summary: Resolves the per-user GPU limit of a partition by reading its QoS via scontrol then querying sacctmgr for the MaxTRESPerUser gres/gpu figure.

nodes.name: parse_slurm_time_s
nodes.summary: Parses SLURM D-HH:MM:SS style time strings (including UNLIMITED) into seconds.

nodes.name: count_user_gpus
nodes.summary: Sums the GPUs the user's running and pending jobs currently request on a partition, parsed from squeue tres-per-node output.

nodes.name: spillover_slots
nodes.summary: Computes how many more jobs fit on a spillover partition: the minimum of the remaining per-user GPU quota and idle GPUs, zeroed when pending jobs exist.

nodes.name: pick_partition
nodes.summary: Chooses the partition for the next job: the primary partition when it has free resources, otherwise the first configured spillover partition with slots within the spillover budget, else None.

nodes.name: gpu_type_exclude_nodes
nodes.summary: Lists nodes on a partition whose GPUs are all outside the allowed GPU types, producing the comma-joined node set for an sbatch exclude directive.

nodes.name: _gpu_exclude_directive
nodes.summary: Builds the #SBATCH --exclude line combining configured excluded nodes with nodes carrying disallowed GPU types.

nodes.name: partition_gpu_type_counts
nodes.summary: Tallies how many GPUs of each type a partition offers from sinfo gres output.

nodes.name: _gres_fragments
nodes.summary: Yields candidate (gres request, exclude directive) sbatch fragment pairs for a partition, preferring typed GPU requests before the generic fallback.

nodes.name: _sbatch_gpu_job
nodes.summary: Shared submission loop for GPU jobs: tries each gres fragment in turn, building the script via the provided callback and submitting with sbatch until one succeeds.

nodes.name: clamp_time_for_partition
nodes.summary: Clamps a train config's requested wall time to the target partition's time limit, returning a model_copy with the adjusted slurm_time.

nodes.name: launch_train_parallel
nodes.summary: Submits a single training run as a SLURM GPU job: dumps the train config to YAML, saves the study config for remote reload, and generates an sbatch script that trains the model and writes the result NetCDF.

nodes.name: launch_agent_parallel
nodes.summary: Submits a W&B sweep agent as a SLURM GPU job, staging the base train config and agent kwargs into a temp directory the generated script reads on the compute node.

nodes.name: launch_case_analysis_parallel
nodes.summary: Submits one CPU SLURM job that runs a case's analysis (stage metrics plus case report) by resolving the study's ANALYSIS_METRICS_MODULE / ANALYSIS_REPORTS_MODULE dotted paths inside the generated script.

nodes.name: launch_trajopt_case_parallel
nodes.summary: Submits a trajectory-optimization case as a SLURM GPU job for the out-of-scope trajectory_optimization study.

nodes.languageNotes: Template-method design: subclasses override only declared hooks (_model_train_spec, _base_loss_config, etc.) and ClassVars; str(case) is load-bearing because it names checkpoint dirs, result files, and SLURM jobs.

nodes.name: real_timeslice_mask

nodes.summary: Evaluates the study result dataset on each retained top-k checkpoint by restoring the trainer per checkpoint, then aggregates them; passes through unchanged when only one checkpoint exists.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview stating the five research questions (architecture choice, exnihilo training, target-shot count, input normalization, domain adaptation method) and describing the three studies (power balance, profile, transport transfer), repo organization, and the split local/cluster workflow.
